focused_gui.scope: Classic v11 light at scale 1 and dark at scale 2 with repeated layout. Adjacent File/Edit/View rows have contiguous 40-point hit targets and 16-point text. File shortcut color remains legible. A real pointer click two points below the Rulers row edge, within the former gap, activates Gridlines; reopening View confirms checked state. Menu interactions preserve document semantics and history ticket.

gpu_scenes.scope: Raw 1360x900 wgpu-backed File/Edit/Save as/Print scenes in light/dark, before and after. The record archives File/Edit comparisons; rendered inspection confirms reduced inter-row spacing, larger text and clearer shortcuts. OS title/menu bars are outside these captures.

regression_baseline.result: The original File probe reports Open top=94 while New bottom=89, exposing a five-point gap between adjacent hit targets.
regression_baseline.probe_scope: The initial File geometry assertion; later Copy-query disambiguation, pointer-gap activation and shortcut contrast checks were added after the baseline failure.

scope: Classic v11 main-menu layout now has zero extra vertical spacing between ordinary 40-point rows, 16-point body/button text and theme-specific primary/secondary text contrast. Separators, icons, shared action identities, shortcuts, enabled state, submenu behavior and PaintCraft extensions are retained. Studio and historical skins keep their own layouts.
limits: Main-menu icons still use the colorful supplied-sheet adaptations and differ from the monochrome reference. Icon styling, unavailable operations, native menu/desktop appearance and complete Windows fidelity remain open. This record qualifies menu density/typography and pointer routing, not the full feature roadmap.
